deleteSchema.json.name: Delete Product
deleteSchema.json.description: Delete a product from an API data source of the connected Merchant Center account. From a primary data source this removes the whole product, including its supplemental values: only insert_product with all attributes adds it again. From a supplemental data source this removes only the values of that data source, and the product keeps its primary values. data_source is the data_source_id or data_source_name of the API data source.
